Subject: Post-signature transition playbook & evaluation cadence for HeliumTech

Hi Priya / Ben —

Thanks again for signing. Attached is a first-pass transition playbook that embeds the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) items we discussed during negotiation. The file highlights the recommended sequence: canary, migration, training, and the evaluation cadence we use to validate quality regressions.

High-level asks for this week:
- Please confirm the internal stakeholders who will own acceptance sign-offs (SRE, Product, Security).
- Identify a single Slack channel or distribution list we can use for day-to-day rollout coordination.
- Confirm the preferred 2-week period for the canary window (we suggested 2028-06-15 to 2028-06-29).

Attached: HeliumTech_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), eval_prompt_set_v2.json (initial eval prompts), network_config_stub.pdf (network checklist).

I'll schedule a 30-min sync once you confirm stakeholders — aim to lock down the canary window and handoff owners.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-06-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature transition playbook & evaluation cadence for HeliumTech

Thanks Priya — 2028-06-18 to 2028-07-02 is fine on our side. I've penciled in reserved capacity on those dates and flagged the canary lane for lower concurrency (target 10r/s for initial 48h).

Regarding rollback triggers: here is our proposed minimal set to include in the MAP (we'll formalize in the spreadsheet):
- Latency: p95 increase >50% from baseline sustained for 10m => trigger investigation and partial rollback.
- Error rate: HTTP 5xx or generation failure rate >2% over 5m => immediate throttling and alert.
- Quality: automated eval A/B score drop >3 pts vs baseline on the eval_prompt_set => pause rollout and require manual sign-off.

Action items for Rishi/Eng:
1) Provide baseline numbers to HeliumTech by 2028-06-05 (Jonas to own collection).
2) Pre-populate the canary evaluation dashboard and set alert thresholds (Rishi/Jonas).
3) Validate network reachability checklist with HeliumTech's SRE before 2028-06-14 (Marissa to coordinate).

I'll attach a short checklist and the baseline snapshot once Jonas is done.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-06-05T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature transition playbook & evaluation cadence for HeliumTech

All —

I've uploaded an updated MAP that includes the rollback thresholds Rishi outlined, plus a more detailed week-by-week training and handoff plan. Visible in the Drive link I shared earlier. Key notes:
- Week -1 (prep): network checks, RBAC accounts, API key rotation rehearsal.
- Week 0 (canary start): 10r/s, targeted customer subset, daily quality eval snapshots at 09:00 PT.
- Week 2 (ramp): increase concurrency to 40r/s if quality stable; begin broader training sessions for HeliumTech ops.

Please review the acceptance matrix (tab: sign-offs) and confirm if the SRE checklist requires additional items (Priya/A rjun/Claire).

Next sync: I'll propose a 30-min alignment on 2028-06-07 10:00 PT to finalize sign-offs and the canary runbook. If that slot doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Neha
